context_for_next_testing_agent: Micro-exit prevention verified. Key thresholds: RL won't CLOSE unless profit >= 0.5% or loss <= -0.6%, won't REDUCE unless profit >= 0.8%. Entry signals require TP >= 1.2% and SL >= 0.35% from entry. Manual position adoption also enforces these minimums. The protective_liq_level metadata now stores final stop_loss, not raw liquidation level. This directly addresses user's XRPUSDT (+0.01% close) and BTCUSDT (-0.02% liquidation_stop) issues.
rca_of_the_issue: User's Telegram logs showed XRPUSDT short closed at +0.01% by 'RL close' and BTCUSDT short at -0.02% by 'liquidation_stop'. Root cause: (1) RLPositionAgent had no minimum profit/loss thresholds - would close on any adverse signal regardless of P&L. (2) TP/SL levels could be set too tight from raw liquidity clusters. Fix: Added min_close_profit_pct/max_panic_loss_pct/min_reduce_profit_pct to RL agent, added min_target_profit_pct/min_stop_distance_pct to EntryEngine, and set protective_liq_level to final stop_loss rather than raw near-liquidation level.
